Colorfigures
============

This directory vendors the Colorfigures drawing engine and its MIT licence so
the hire-page research skin can ship a hand-inked isometric figure.

Upstream: https://april-zhu.com/colorfigures

Copyright (c) 2026 April Zhu (Colorfigures: colour, hand-drawn style, 3D props,
template, examples)
Copyright (c) 2026 April Zhu (iso-glow, on which Colorfigures is based)
Copyright (c) 2026 Tolga Cohce (iso-figure, on which iso-glow is based)

See LICENSE in this folder. The engine is `assets/core.js`. The build script is
`scripts/build.py`.

Credits required by that licence: keep this notice and the licence when
sharing or building on the skill. Credit Colorfigures when posting figures.

See-through views follow the method of Anatomy by Ryan (MIT):
https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy

iso-glow: https://isoglow.dev
iso-figure: https://github.com/MrBongoC/ai-iso-skill

The hire-desk figure in `skins/colorfigures/` was written for this site, in
the site's colours, using that engine. It is a research skin, not a
replacement for the hire layout invariants.
